name: print-social-orange-digital-agency-ad-with-selective-colour-photo
title: White and orange agency ad with a greyscale man in an orange shirt and glossy 3D icons
whatItIs: A square ad with a grinning man in glasses whose photo is greyscale except his orange shirt, orange 3D thumbs-up and like spheres, a headline mixing solid orange 'DIGITAL', outlined 'MARKETING' and black 'AGENCY', a services list and a slanted orange footer.
whatItMeans: Loud and cheeky; selective colour ties the person directly to the brand hue.
techniques: Keep only brand-coloured items in colour.
Mix solid and outline type in one headline.
Float glossy 3D icons as social signals.
Slant the footer band for motion.

vocabulary.definition: A mostly greyscale photo with one colour kept.
